text:
maya_p: quick RFC follow-up — smoothing + abuse-score handoff. thinking about the admission <-> abuse interface. TL;DR: propose we send a compact canonical signal (score + ttl + tags) from abuse svc to admission, and keep raw event stream for analytics. opinions?

samuel_k: +1 to compact signal. admission should stay simple. Q: how do we handle rapid flips (score oscillation)?

maya_p: good Q. my thought: add a probation/stability window on the abuse side and a small 'stability' flag in the canonical signal. if score flips within window we mark stability=false and give shorter ttl. otherwise stability=true and normal ttl. where should the debounce live — admission or abuse?

alex_w: keep debounce in abuse svc. admission should consume a canonical decision: {score, ttl, tags, stability}. that way admission is stateless and easier to reason about. complexity belongs with abuse where we can run offline evals.
jordan_t: big caveat: what if abuse svc is unreachable? admission needs a fallback. suggest: local cache of last canonical signal + degrade mode (conservative QPS) after N seconds of no contact. also emit an alert metric.

lia_ops: ops requirements: we need explicit histograms for ttl_jitter and time_since_emit, and a "score_source" tag (raw|aggregated|simulated). also want synthetic probes that flip scores to validate admission behavior. :eyes:

maya_p: agree. API sketch below — lightweight JSON over protobuf/gRPC:

```json
{"score": 0.72, "ttl_ms": 30000, "tags": ["probation","high-throughput"], "stability": "true", "version": "v1"}
```

alex_w: add confidence and event_count so admission can optionally adjust serving thresholds:

```json
{"score": 0.72, "confidence": 0.85, "event_count": 42, "ttl_ms": 30000, "tags": ["probation","high-throughput"], "stability": "true", "version": "v1"}
```

samuel_k: i'll put up a short PR for the admission shim + unit/integration test that simulates flip/flap scenarios (30s windows etc.). will also add the fallback cache behavior.

abuse-bot: New RFC follow-up posted: https://git.internal.redwood/rfcs/1243 (abuse-canonical-signal).

maya_p: great — thanks all. can we review PR by EOD Friday? if yes I'll coordinate with infra to add probe jobs. :thumbsup:
